book.name: 1 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Okurwaaza amangʼana iguru wa Yeesu Krisito
Abhahiiri bhaane, hano nikaaza kweemwe okubharwaazira iguru ye embiso ya Taatabhugya yino yaari ebhisirwe,
nitaagaambiri kwa amangʼana go obhusomi naabhe kwa amangʼeeni.
Hano niari kweemwe, nikaamura nigaambe amangʼana iguru wa Yeesu Krisito ego, kiindi okukwa kwaaye kumusaraba, kutama okugaamba kigiro ekiindi.
Eriibhaga riyo niari munyookobhu, niari ne ehaho, no okurigita bhukongʼu.
Hano niari nikweegya no okurwaaza, nitaagaambiri kwa amangʼeeni gaane, okubha nibhakorokoombe abhaatu kwe ekigirirye kya amangʼeeni, nawe amanaga ge Ekoro Muhoreeru gaari gareerekya obhuheene.
Nikakora ego, okubha obhwiikirirya bhweenyu bhutiisigira amangʼeeni ga abhaatu, nawe bhwiisigire amanaga ga Taatabhugya.
Amangʼeeni okurwa kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru
Bhoono etwe, turagaamba amangʼana ga amangʼeeni kubhaatu bhano bhakongʼiri mubhwiikirirya, nawe amangʼeeni gayo gatari ge ekyaaro kino, na gatari ga abhakaangati bhe ekyaaro kino bhano bharaabhure.

Amangʼeeni gano tukurwaaza ni mbiso ya Taatabhugya, yino yaari ebhisirwe okubha abhaatu bhatayimenya. Hano Taatabhugya yaari akyaari kuteema ekyaaro, akaamura kuhokeerya amangʼeeni gayo, okubha atukorere amazomu.
Atariho naabhe owumwe wa abhakaangati bhe ekyaaro kino, wuno yamenyiri amangʼeeni gayo, kwo okubha bhaangabheeri bhagamenyiri, bhatiingamutemereeri kumusaraba Omukuru wo obhuguungo.
Ni kyeego ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru kubha,

content.text: atariho omuutu wuno yaakagaruuzi naabhe okugiigwa,
atariho omuutu wuno yaakagatuuriri mukoro yaaye.”

content: Nawe etwe, Taatabhugya akatweerekya gayo kuhitira kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru, kwo okubha Ekoro Muhoreeru ariisuunza goosi, naabhe amiiseego ga Taatabhugya gano gabhisirwe.

Atariho omuutu wuno akunagya kumenya gano omuutu owuundi akwiiseega. Nawe ekoro yaaye omweene ego egamenyiri. Egoego na gano Taatabhugya akwiiseega, atariho wuno akunagya okugamenya. Nawe Ekoro wa Taatabhugya omweene agamenyiri.
Taatabhugya atuheeri etwe Ekoro yaaye, okubha tugamenye gano tuheerwe kwo orubhaango rwa Taatabhugya. Kweego tutakwiiseega kyeego abhaatu bhe ekyaaro bhakwiiseega.

Kweeki tutakugaamba amangʼana gano tweegiibhwe na amangʼeeni ga abhaatu, nawe amangʼana gano tweegiibhwe ne Ekoro wa Taatabhugya. Turagagarura amangʼana ge Ekoro wa Taatabhugya kubhano bhane Ekoro wuyo.

Nawe omuutu wuno atana Ekoro wa Taatabhugya, atakusuungʼaana gano gakurwa kwe Ekoro wa Taatabhugya, kwe ekigirirye kweewe gayo ni ga bhweene ego. Kweeki atakunagya kugamenya, kwe ekigirirye garamenyekana ageene kwo obhusakirya bhwe Ekoro wa Taatabhugya.
Omuutu wuno akukaangatwa ne Ekoro wa Taatabhugya aragamenya goosi, nawe ewe, atakunagya kumenyekana no omuutu wuyo woosi.
Ni kyeego Amakaamo Amahoreeru gakubhuga,

content.text: “Ni weewi wuno amenyiri gano Omukuru, Taatabhugya akwiiseega?
Kweeki ni weewi wuno akunagya kumutoongera?”

content: Nawe, etwe turiiseega amangʼana kya gano Krisito akwiiseega.

footnotes.text: Embiso ya Taatabhugya yino yaari ebhisirwe, amakaamo agaandi ge Ekiyunaani garabhuga, obhugaambi iguru wa Taatabhugya.
Kubhano bhane Ekoro wuyo, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, kumangʼana ge ekoro.
